project_type: Python FastAPI async web application with Jinja2 templates
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient, SQLite test fixtures in conftest.py
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv sync' to install deps. 2. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' to confirm all tests pass. 3. Run 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' to confirm no lint errors.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/edms  2. uv sync  3. Tests: uv run pytest tests/ -v
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11.14 via pyenv. uv package manager. No Docker daemon confirmed available. SQLite for tests (aiosqlite). No PostgreSQL server running - all DB tests use in-memory SQLite.
contribution_requirements: Tests must pass (170 existing). Code style: ruff. Async patterns throughout. Models inherit from app.models.group.Base (DeclarativeBase).
key_patterns: 1. Models in app/models/ inherit from Base in group.py. 2. API routes in app/api/ with APIRouter, registered in app/api/router.py. 3. Auth uses HTTPBearer + JWT (python-jose), passlib/bcrypt for passwords. 4. Templates use Jinja2 with Tailwind CSS (CDN) + htmx. 5. Config via pydantic-settings in app/core/config.py. 6. Tests override get_db with SQLite fixture. 7. Services in app/services/. 8. Schemas in app/schemas/. 9. The rbac-org repo uses synchronous SQLAlchemy with raw SQL (fetch_all/fetch_one/execute helpers) and PostgreSQL-specific features (UUID PKs, org schema, array_agg). Integration must adapt to async SQLAlchemy ORM pattern used by EDMS.
directory_structure: app/ - main application (api/, core/, models/, schemas/, services/, templates/). tests/ - pytest suite. wiki/ - LLM wiki output. chroma_db/ - ChromaDB vectors. /projects/sandbox/rbac-org/ - reference RBAC system to integrate.
